entities.summary: Ezrom Kgobokanyo Sebata Legae was a South African sculptor, draughtsman, and teacher. Together with Anton van Wouw, Edoardo Villa and Sydney Kumalo he is regarded as one of South Africa's best sculptors. In addition, he is considered a foremost South African draughtsman.
